## Purpose
The process-knowledge contract every pipeline layer goes through:
- `block` renders a layer's view;
- `record` and `record_refs` note what the layer used;
- `persist` writes the usage and annotates the built subject.

All of them do nothing when the feature is off, so prompts stay byte-for-byte the same.

## Responsibilities
- **Keys:** `CONTEXT_KEY="process_context"` and `USAGE_KEY="_process_usage"`.
- **`active(ctx)`** returns the context only when it is enabled and has documents.
- **`block(ctx, view, focus, refs=True, extra_instruction)`** returns `"\n\n" + context.render(pc, view, focus)`, plus `refs_instruction(extra)`. It returns "" when inactive or when rendering fails.
- **`record(ctx, layer, items)`:**
  - keeps only refs that are in the context's index;
  - each entry is `{ref, type, label, how ≤400, target, document_id, document_version, concept_id}`;
  - de-duplicates on `(ref, target, how)`.
- **`record_refs(ctx, layer, data, target)`** reads `data.process_refs`, given as strings or `{ref, how, target}`.
- **Readers:** `usage_for(ctx, layer)` and `all_usage(ctx)`.
- **`persist(ctx, subject_type, subject_id, subject_name, target)`:**
  - writes one row per recorded entry, filtered by `target`, with how = "[target] how";
  - also writes one row per document, with layer `process_knowledge`, element `document:<id>` and how "<role> document (<mode>)";
  - annotates the subject with `IMPLEMENTS_PROCESS` and the document's concept;
  - writes everything through `store.record_usage`. It never raises.

## Interactions
- **Used by:** every decision layer (through `DecisionLayer.process_block`), `KnowledgeContextLayer` and `revision/context_layer`.
- **Mirrored by:** `knowledge.pipeline`.

## Error handling and edge cases
A failure while rendering a view gives "".

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The usage dict is created before any concurrent group runs,** so every branch snapshot writes into the same object. `emit_layer` then attaches a layer's entries to its completed event.
- **Each document is always recorded,** so "used by" never under-reports.
